title: A Restricted Reserve Comes Back Online
body: Activation is the dominant operation here, and the signals agree with each other rather than pulling apart — a capacity or resource that had been sitting unused or restricted is becoming available again, and the trend is still climbing. This reads as material or operational: budget, staffing, equipment, or standing authority that had been held back is now back in active use.
notes: Adapted from legacy_dfis_rising.json (predictive_window_blocks.json, DFIS/rising). Original routed on the retired leading_index dimension (DFIS = 'Power Current') and framed the content as personal-authority reclamation ('self-protection', 'your own authority') — identity/therapeutic language this lane is meant to avoid. Kept: the underlying 'held-back capacity becomes active' structure, and the rising-gradient timing. Rewrote: conditions now route on real engine fields (dominant_operation=activate, semantic_state=reinforcing, gradient=rising) instead of the leading_index enum, and the prose was recast as a material/operational texture with no reference to identity, self-protection, or authority. Re-filed from legacy_conversion into the real pressure_system family since 'a restricted reserve becoming active again' is a pressure/capacity read, not a timing or threshold one.
